additionalSource.locator: Printed pages 4 and 7 confirm switching limits and diode load; no additional generator or diode device parameters found

findings: RFT fixture 126 places D1 from the resistor-fed load node toward the output; D2–D4 form the forward series string from load node to ground. The output capacitance and load resistor use the published values.
The generic buffer reaches timestep-converged threshold brackets for the selected explicit generator assumptions.

At slower assumed input edges, output falling threshold crossings precede input 1.5 V crossings. The diagnostic nonnegative-delay screen therefore fails; this is not a violation of a published RFT minimum-delay bound.

Fast-edge delays below the published maxima do not establish physical switching accuracy: the model has uncalibrated storage/capacitance and the reviewed fixture lacks complete generator and diode specifications.
nextAction: Keep switching unqualified; seek independent dynamic device evidence and preserve an explicit candidate boundary when integrating the host path into firmware observation.
